description: This file defines the FilesBackupService class, which manages backup operations for files, including enabling/disabling backups, handling file changes, and reading encrypted backups. It interacts with various interfaces and services related to file backups within the application.

classes.name: FilesBackupService
classes.description: A service class responsible for managing file backup operations, including enabling/disabling backups, handling file changes, and reading encrypted backups.

methods.name: isFilesBackupsEnabled
methods.description: Checks if file backups are enabled on the device.

methods.name: enableFilesBackups
methods.description: Enables file backups and initiates backup of all files if successful.

methods.name: disableFilesBackups
methods.description: Disables file backups on the device.

methods.name: changeFilesBackupsLocation
methods.description: Changes the location for file backups.

methods.name: getFilesBackupsLocation
methods.description: Retrieves the current location of file backups.

methods.name: openFilesBackupsLocation
methods.description: Opens the file backups location in the file system.

methods.name: getBackupsMappingFromDisk
methods.description: Retrieves the file backups mapping from disk.

methods.name: getBackupsMappingFromCache
methods.description: Retrieves the backups mapping from cache or disk if cache is empty.

methods.name: getFileBackupInfo
methods.description: Gets backup information for a specific file by UUID.

methods.name: handleChangedFiles
methods.description: Handles changes in files, triggering backups for new or changed files.

methods.name: readEncryptedFileFromBackup
methods.description: Reads an encrypted file from backup, streaming chunks via callback.

methods.name: performBackupOperation
methods.description: Performs backup of a single file, including encryption and metadata creation.
